notes.title: v0.025 - Sounds and Multiplayer Stuff
notes.content:
First Steam update is here, nothing huge but a bunch of multiplayer fixes and new sounds

 Fixed chat messages resetting when you respawn
 Fixed multiplayer ragdolls freaking out on death
 Fixed player collision not turning off when dead
 Added the hitsounds/visual for when hitting players now too
 Added sound effects for seed impacts, potion slime impacts and zombie bottles, although theyre not necessarily final
 Added electrocution dissolve effect to players
 Garry now drops when you die
 Moved dash meter down to bottom centre, still not sure about it but its less distracting I guess
 Fixed zombie bottles not spawning as the alternate ones if they were holding it but I dont think anyone actually noticed that
 Fixed not being able to select characters if no saved settings existed yet (not sure if you guys ran into this and didnt mention it or didnt even try to pick another character, but either way maybe that explains why everyone was Stanley)
